findings.name: exotic-source
findings.title: resolved from a git repository instead of PyPI
findings.explanation: uv.lock resolves pypi:typeshed-client@2.8.2 from a git repository (https://github.com/JelleZijlstra/typeshed_client?rev=9d4b258bbad66421ee2d9ea8cf02768ffb782a1a#9d4b258bbad66421ee2d9ea8cf02768ffb782a1a) rather than from PyPI. None of the registry's protections apply to it: the release cannot be yanked, advisories are not matched against it, and there is no publisher, provenance or download history to compare with the previous version. The version number the lockfile records is what the fetched manifest claimed, not a version anyone published. The revision 9d4b258bbad66421ee2d9ea8cf02768ffb782a1a is a full commit sha, so at least the content is pinned.
